capabilities: Continuous optimization under exact acyclicity constraint
limitation: Acyclicity is not causal identification; inspect numerical thresholding
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Data, regression loss, sparsity and numerical convergence/threshold choices.
scientific_qualification.output: Estimated adjacency under an acyclicity constraint.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Graph interpretation needs structural/noise identifiability and valid observations beyond a differentiable DAG constraint.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Expose solver failure and thresholding; preserve pre-threshold weights. Do not label every fitted acyclic graph uniquely identified.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use a cyclic near-threshold candidate, equivalent linear-Gaussian DAGs and a nonlinear identifiable case; compare feasibility with intervention correctness.

evidence.finding: Continuous constrained structure-learning formulation and reference code usage.
